mapper.sql: id, name, slug, alias_name, description, category, meeting_schedule, schedule_note, location, contact_email, advisor, image_url, (SELECT link_url FROM club_social_medias WHERE club_id = clubs.id AND social_type = 'instagram' LIMIT 1) AS instagram_url, member_count, achievements, school_id, status, visibility, approved_at, approved_by_oauth_user_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM clubs WHERE ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT FROM clubs WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clubs WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clubs (name, slug, alias_name, description, category, meeting_schedule, schedule_note, location, contact_email, advisor, image_url, member_count, achievements, school_id, status, visibility) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{aliasName}, #{description}, #{category}, #{meetingSchedule}, #{scheduleNote}, #{location}, #{contactEmail}, #{advisor}, #{imageUrl}, #{memberCount}, #{achievements, typeHandler=com.example.demo.club.mapper.AchievementsTypeHandler}, #{schoolId}, #{status}, #{visibility})
mapper.update: UPDATE clubs SET name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, alias_name = #{aliasName}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, meeting_schedule = #{meetingSchedule}, schedule_note = #{scheduleNote}, location = #{location}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, advisor = #{advisor}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, member_count = #{memberCount}, achievements = #{achievements, typeHandler=com.example.demo.club.mapper.AchievementsTypeHandler}, school_id = #{schoolId}, status = #{status}, visibility = #{visibility} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cm.oauth_user_id, ou.display_name, ou.email, ou.avatar_url, cm.role_name FROM club_member cm JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cm.oauth_user_id WHERE cm.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY COALESCE(cm.role_name, 'member') DESC, ou.display_name
SELECT TRUE AS is_member, cm.role_name FROM club_member cm JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cm.oauth_user_id WHERE cm.club_id = #{clubId} AND LOWER(ou.email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_member (club_id, oauth_user_id, role_name) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{oauthUserId}, #{roleName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_name = VALUES(role_name)
mapper.select: SELECT cmr.id, cmr.club_id, cmr.oauth_user_id, ou.display_name, ou.email, ou.avatar_url, cmr.created_at, cmr.status, cmr.reviewed_at, cmr.reviewed_by_oauth_user_id, cmr.note FROM club_membership_requests cmr JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cmr.oauth_user_id WHERE cmr.club_id = #{clubId} AND cmr.status = 'pending' ORDER BY cmr.created_at ASC

SELECT cmr.id, cmr.club_id, cmr.oauth_user_id, ou.display_name, ou.email, ou.avatar_url, cmr.created_at, cmr.status, cmr.reviewed_at, cmr.reviewed_by_oauth_user_id, cmr.note FROM club_membership_requests cmr JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cmr.oauth_user_id WHERE cmr.club_id = #{clubId} AND cmr.oauth_user_id = #{oauthUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cmr.id, cmr.club_id, cmr.oauth_user_id, ou.display_name, ou.email, ou.avatar_url, cmr.created_at, cmr.status, cmr.reviewed_at, cmr.reviewed_by_oauth_user_id, cmr.note FROM club_membership_requests cmr JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cmr.oauth_user_id WHERE cmr.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
